label: DRIFT+MISALIGNMENT: the fan-out slot for glm-5.3-flash is still justified in code by 'it bills a flat-price plan rather than per token' (executor-config.ts:250), the exact billing claim v4.0.0.0's own 'What the Caching Is Actually Worth' section retracted as wrong (per-token at list rates, 3x credit bonus, 48.6% measured saving on GLM). The comment is the durable WHY for a provider choice and now carries a false premise a maintainer can re-rank cost on.

IMPROVEMENT (operator UX): cli-pi row PI-017 verifies the roster with sed -n '210,256p' and a hand-written list of ten literal ids; the allowlist actually spans 228-251 with PI_DEFAULT_MODEL at 256, so the pinned range over-reads 18 comment lines and stops one line short of the closing tuple. It passes today and fails silently on the next edit above line 210, and the ten literals must be re-typed on every roster change.

v4.0.0.0 'no router agent left to call' holds: .skilled/agents has 12 entries and .opencode/agents only the deep pair; no deep/deep-loop router persona, and @deep-loop grep hits are the @deep-loop/runtime package name.

v4.0.0.0 smart-routing to root ROUTER.md move holds: ROUTER.md sits at the hub root with its own provenance note, and every remaining smart-routing reference is a historical changelog the move's entry explicitly permits.

v4.0.0.0 pi roster default holds: PI_DEFAULT_MODEL is deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 and the roster is a readonly const behind isPiModelAllowed. The note's six-provider arithmetic was not confirmed because bare literals resolve their provider outside this file.

v4.0.0.16 fast-mode half of the terra claim is neither confirmed nor refuted: a priority/service_tier grep over .pi/extensions/pi-fast-mode-w-subagent-support matched only benchmark fixtures, no source, so the tier map still needs a direct read.
